messages:
Maya: Heads up — AtlasFlare is ready for Dedicated cutover. Want to schedule slice rollout tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Request pin to runtime v2.14.1-rc3 and model rdl-1.3 (no DB changes).
Ashwin: ack. v2.14.1-rc3 includes KV-cache fixes and a kernel fallback for older GPUs. I can own the rollout.
Elaine: SRE ask — canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, full if stable. Rollback if error rate > 1% or p50 latency +200ms over baseline.
Rebecca: Checklist: release notes link, infra capacity, CSM notif, rollback plan, telemetry dashboards. I'll paste the checklist in a sec.
deploy-bot: Deploy job created: deploy://atlasflare/slice-7 at 2024-04-15T02:00:00Z by Ashwin. CI: green, canary plan set. Logs: https://deploy.redwood/atlasflare/12345
Sam: I emailed AtlasFlare CSM contact (cc'd ops) with proposed window 02:00 UTC; they asked for a 1h maintenance window and a pre-cutover heads-up 30m prior. Done.
Jon: Infra confirmed — pool-dedicated-4 reserved, capacity +5 GPUs, NLB rules already include customer CIDR.
Ashwin: Pin details: runtime=v2.14.1-rc3, model=rdl-1.3-quant, quant_profile=q8_0. Rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (manual checks between stages).
Rebecca: Release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/rdl-1.3. Short summary pasted in thread for CS/Legal. No migrations. No firewall changes.
Elaine: Ops runbook snippet:
```
# rollback criteria
if metrics.error_rate > 0.01 or metrics.p50_latency > baseline + 0.2s:
  announce "rolling back atlasflare slice"
  run rollback --slice atlasflare/slice-7 --to-image previous
  notify #incidents and oncall
```
Also monitor token throughput and KV eviction rates for first 15m.
Maya: Added a staged fallback: if model quant errors spike, route to rdl-1.2 as automatic fallback.
Ashwin: Will attach pinned config to the deploy job and upload artifacts. Command I'll run:
```
deploy run --slice atlasflare/slice-7 \\
  --runtime v2.14.1-rc3 \\
  --model rdl-1.3-quant \\
  --quant-profile q8_0 \\
  --canary 5% --canary-duration 30m
```
Rebecca: approvals? please react with :thumbsup: or say GO/NO-GO. We need at least eng, sre, and release signoff.
Jon: :thumbsup: infra good.
Elaine: :thumbsup: SRE good on thresholds and monitoring.
Ashwin: GO from runtime side.
Maya: GO — customer notified and ok with window.
Sam: I confirmed customer maintenance window and post-cutover followup. :thumbsup:
Rebecca: All set. Scheduling final deploy trigger 2024-04-15T02:00:00Z. I will paste final rollout notes to AtlasFlare CSM 30m before.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2024-04-15T01:30:00Z — pre-cutover notification to #eng-releases and CSMs.
Rebecca: GO for 02:00 UTC. :green_heart: End-to-end owners on watch.
